series.name: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash)
series.notes: A-control check codes for wall splits + Mr. Slim P-Series A. Primary = ME Malaysia troubleshooting (official, high) corroborated by MrSlimErrorCode-V2.pdf (ME SG), ME UK/IE Fault Code Check List (orionair mirror), ME HK user manual, arma.org.au PDF. High. Remote check / outdoor LED / central controller display routes.

title.ur: Koi kharabi nahi (normal)

meaning.en: Self-diagnosis reports no abnormality; the check display returns 00.
meaning.ur: Self-diagnosis mein koi kharabi nahi milti; check display par 00 aata hai.

causes.en: Unit is operating within normal parameters
causes.ur: Unit normal parameters ke andar kaam kar rahi hai.

causes.en: No fault is latched in the indoor controller memory
causes.ur: Indoor controller memory mein koi fault save nahi hai.

solutions.en: If the unit still misbehaves, check filters, airflow and set temperature rather than the code
solutions.ur: Agar unit phir bhi theek na chale to code ki bajaye filters, airflow aur set temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Clear the code history after service and re-test
solutions.ur: Service ke baad code history clear karein aur dobara test karein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S1]

notes.en: 00 is explicitly defined as None (Normal) in the official ME Malaysia and ME HK user-manual tables.
notes.ur: Official ME Malaysia aur ME HK user-manual tables mein 00 ko explicitly None (Normal) define kiya gaya hai.

title.ur: Room temperature thermistor mein kharabi

meaning.en: The room air temperature thermistor (TH1 / RT1) reads open or short circuit, so the unit cannot judge room temperature.
meaning.ur: Room air temperature thermistor (TH1 / RT1) open ya short ho gaya hai, is liye unit room temperature ka andaza nahi laga sakti.

causes.en: Bad contact of the thermistor connector on the indoor controller board
causes.ur: Indoor controller board par thermistor connector ka contact theek nahi hai.

causes.en: Damaged / drifted thermistor (open or shorted element)
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho gaya ho ya value drift kar rahi ho (element open/short).

solutions.en: Check and re-seat the TH1 connector, then measure thermistor resistance against the official table (0°C ≈ 15 kΩ, 20°C ≈ 6.3–6.4 kΩ, 30°C ≈ 4.3 kΩ)
solutions.ur: TH1 connector check karke dobara theek se lagayein, phir official table se thermistor ki resistance naapein (0°C ≈ 15 kΩ, 20°C ≈ 6.3–6.4 kΩ, 30°C ≈ 4.3 kΩ).

solutions.en: If resistance is in spec but the code persists, replace the indoor controller board
solutions.ur: Agar resistance specification mein hai lekin code barqarar rahe to indoor controller board badlein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S1]

notes.en: Confirmed identical across S1, S2, S8, S10, S12 — highest-agreement code in the set.
notes.ur: S1, S2, S8, S10, S12 mein yeh bilkul same confirm hua hai — poore set mein sab se zyada agreement wala code.

title.en: Indoor coil / liquid pipe thermistor abnormality
title.ur: Indoor coil / liquid pipe thermistor mein kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor heat-exchanger (coil / liquid pipe) thermistor TH2 reads open or short circuit.
meaning.ur: Indoor heat exchanger (coil / liquid pipe) ka thermistor TH2 open ya short ho gaya hai, jis se pipe ki temperature theek se nahi mil rahi.

causes.en: Contact failure of the TH2 connector on the indoor controller board
causes.ur: Indoor controller board par TH2 connector ka contact nahi banta.

causes.en: Thermistor open / short or mounted off the pipe
causes.ur: Thermistor open/short ho ya pipe par sahi jagah na laga ho.

solutions.en: Measure TH2 resistance and compare with the official resistance table; check the pipe holder position
solutions.ur: TH2 ki resistance naapein aur official resistance table se compare karein; pipe holder ki position check karein.

solutions.en: If resistance is normal, replace the indoor controller board
solutions.ur: Agar resistance normal ho to indoor controller board badlein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S1]

notes.en: S2 groups P2 with P9 in beeper count 2; S12 lists P2 as pipe/liquid thermistor TH2.
notes.ur: S2 beeper count 2 mein P2 ko P9 ke sath group karta hai; S12 mein P2 pipe/liquid thermistor TH2 hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor upper lamp: 2-time flash, 2.5 s OFF; wireless remote beeper: 2 times (also covers P9)

title.en: Drain sensor abnormality / float switch connector open
title.ur: Drain sensor kharab / float switch connector open

meaning.en: The condensate drain sensor circuit is open or shorted (or the float-switch connector is unplugged), so overflow cannot be detected.
meaning.ur: Condensate drain sensor ka circuit open ya short hai (ya float switch connector nikal hua hai), is liye overflow detect nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Loose or disconnected drain-sensor / float-switch connector (CN31 / CN4F)
causes.ur: Drain-sensor / float-switch connector (CN31 / CN4F) dhila ho ya khud juda ho jaye.

causes.en: Damaged drain sensor element
causes.ur: Drain sensor ka element kharab ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check and re-seat the CN31 / CN4F connector on the indoor controller board
solutions.ur: Indoor controller board par CN31 / CN4F connector check karke dobara theek se lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance (same characteristic table as P1) and replace the sensor if it is out of range
solutions.ur: Sensor ki resistance naapein (wahi characteristic table jo P1 mein hai) aur agar range se bahar ho to sensor badlein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S2]

notes.en: S2 wording for P4 is 'Float switch connector open'; S10/S12 wording is 'drain sensor abnormality' — same circuit.
notes.ur: P4 ke liye S2 ka alfaz 'Float switch connector open' hai; S10/S12 ka alfaz 'drain sensor abnormality' hai — wahi circuit.

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: 4 times; P-Series A: LED1 4 flashes / LED2 2 flashes

title.en: Drain pump error / drain overflow protection
title.ur: Drain pump ki ghalti / drain overflow protection

meaning.en: The drain pump is not running or high condensate level has been detected and overflow protection has tripped.
meaning.ur: Drain pump nahi chal raha ya condensate ka level zyada hone par overflow protection chali hai.

causes.en: Drain pump motor failure or pump not receiving power
causes.ur: Drain pump motor fail ho jaye ya pump ko power na mile.

causes.en: Blocked drain pipe / tray, or a faulty float switch keeping the level high
causes.ur: Drain pipe / tray block ho, ya float switch kharab ho jis se level high bana rahe ho.

solutions.en: Check the drain pump supply and windings, and confirm it actually pumps
solutions.ur: Drain pump ki supply aur windings check karein, aur confirm karein ke woh sach mein pani phenk raha hai.

solutions.en: Clear the drain line and tray, clean the filter, then re-run and re-check the float switch
solutions.ur: Drain line aur tray kholein, filter saaf karein, phir unit dobara chalayein aur float switch ko dobara check karein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S2]

notes.en: Water leakage complaints in PK installs are usually P5/PA rather than a genuine refrigerant fault.
notes.ur: PK installs mein pani ke leakage ki shikayat aksar P5/PA hoti hai, asal refrigerant fault nahi hota.

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: 5 times (also covers PA); P-Series A: LED1 4 flashes / LED2 2 flashes

title.ur: Freeze (cooling) / overheat (heating) protection chala

meaning.en: The indoor coil has frozen in cooling or overheated in heating, so the unit stops to protect the heat exchanger.
meaning.ur: Cooling mein indoor coil par barf lag gayi ya heating mein coil zyada garm ho gayi, is liye heat exchanger bachane ke liye unit band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Dirty air filter or blocked heat exchanger reducing airflow
causes.ur: Air filter ganda ho ya heat exchanger block ho jis se airflow kam ho.

causes.en: Short air cycle (obstruction around inlet/outlet) or indoor fan motor problem
causes.ur: Short air cycle ho (inlet/outlet ke ird-gird rukawat) ya indoor fan motor mein masla ho.

causes.en: Refrigerant undercharge / abnormal refrigerant temperature
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam ho ya refrigerant ki temperature abnormal ho.

solutions.en: Clean the air filter and heat exchanger and clear obstructions from the air path
solutions.ur: Air filter aur heat exchanger saaf karein aur air path se rukawatein hata dein.

solutions.en: Check the indoor fan motor and measure refrigerant charge / operating pressures
solutions.ur: Indoor fan motor check karein aur refrigerant charge / operating pressures naapein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S8]

notes.en: Most common PK field code after filter neglect; often clears after cleaning but recurs if charge is low.
notes.ur: Filter ki safai na karne ke baad PK mein yeh sab se aam field code hai; aksar safai ke baad theek ho jata hai lekin charge kam ho to wapas aata hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: 6 times; P-Series A: LED1 4 flashes / LED2 3 flashes

title.en: Abnormal pipe temperature / 4-way valve pipe temperature
title.ur: Pipe temperature abnormal / 4-way valve pipe temperature

meaning.en: No expected temperature change was seen at the indoor coil pipe within the detection window, or the 4-way valve / pipe temperature is out of range.
meaning.ur: Detection window mein indoor coil ki pipe par temperature ka expected badlav nahi dekha gaya, ya 4-way valve / pipe temperature range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant leakage or insufficient charge
causes.ur: Refrigerant leak ho ya charge kam ho.

causes.en: Outdoor unit tripped / stop valve not fully open
causes.ur: Outdoor unit trip ho jaye / stop valve puri tarah khula na ho.

causes.en: Thermistor TH2/TH5 not seated, or extension piping reversed on multi-unit connections
causes.ur: Thermistor TH2/TH5 sahi tarah laga na ho, ya multi-unit connections mein extension piping ulti ho.

solutions.en: Open the service valves, check the outdoor unit status and leak-test the circuit, then re-gas and vacuum
solutions.ur: Service valves kholein, outdoor unit ki halat check karein aur circuit ka leak-test karein, phir gas vacuum karke bharein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the pipe thermistors and verify piping/wiring polarity on twin or triple connections
solutions.ur: Pipe thermistors ko dobara theek se lagayein aur twin/triple connections mein piping/wiring ki polarity verify karein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S8]

notes.en: S12 states the usual cause is refrigerant leakage; S1 assigns the outdoor 4-way-valve/pipe-temperature meaning.
notes.ur: S12 ke mutabiq aam wajah refrigerant leakage hai; S1 outdoor 4-way-valve/pipe-temperature matlab deta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: 8 times; P-Series A: LED1 4 flashes / LED2 4 flashes

title.ur: Condenser/evaporator pipe thermistor (TH5) mein kharabi

meaning.en: The TH5 pipe thermistor (condenser/evaporator side) is open, shorted or disconnected from the board.
meaning.ur: TH5 pipe thermistor (condenser/evaporator side) open ho gaya, short ho gaya ya board se nikal gaya hai.

causes.en: Open / short circuit of the TH5 element
causes.ur: TH5 element open/short circuit ho jaye.

causes.en: Connector (CN44) contact failure on the indoor controller board
causes.ur: Indoor controller board par connector (CN44) ka contact nahi banta.

solutions.en: Measure TH5 resistance against the official table and check the CN44 connector
solutions.ur: TH5 ki resistance official table se naapein aur CN44 connector check karein.

solutions.en: If the thermistor tests good, replace the indoor controller board
solutions.ur: Agar thermistor ki test theek aaye to indoor controller board badlein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S2]

notes.en: S8 lists P9 separately from P2 even though both land on LED1 4-flash / LED2 1-flash.
notes.ur: S8 mein P9 ko P2 se alag rakha hai halanke dono LED1 4-flash / LED2 1-flash par aate hain.

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: 2 times (grouped with P2); P-Series A: LED1 4 flashes / LED2 1 flash

title.ur: Pani ki kharabi ki wajah se compressor band

meaning.en: The controller has forced the compressor off because a water-leakage / drain-overflow condition was detected.
meaning.ur: Pani ke leakage ya drain overflow ki condition detect hone ki wajah se controller ne compressor ko majboor band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Float switch stuck or triggered by condensate in the tray
causes.ur: Float switch atka ho jaye ya tray mein pani se trigger ho jaye.

causes.en: Drain overflow caused by a blocked drain line
causes.ur: Drain line block hone ki wajah se drain overflow ho jaye.

solutions.en: Empty and clean the drain tray, free the float switch and clear the drain path
solutions.ur: Drain tray khali karein aur saaf karein, float switch azaad karein aur drain path kholein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the unit after the tray is dry and confirm the float switch operation
solutions.ur: Tray sukha hone ke baad unit ka power cycle karein aur float switch ka kaam confirm karein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S2]

notes.en: ME UK checklist calls the same protection 'water leak' behaviour on PWFY/City Multi as code 2500.
notes.ur: ME UK checklist usi protection ko PWFY/City Multi par code 2500 ki tarah 'water leak' behaviour kehte hain.

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: 5 times (grouped with P5)

title.ur: Indoor unit fan motor kharab

meaning.en: The indoor fan motor is not producing the expected rotation feedback (locked, disconnected or PCB fault).
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor expected rotation feedback nahi de raha (lock ho gaya, disconnect ya PCB kharab).

causes.en: Indoor fan motor failure or blocked impeller
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor fail ho jaye ya impeller block ho jaye.

causes.en: Motor connector / indoor PCB fault
causes.ur: Motor connector / indoor PCB mein masla ho.

solutions.en: Check the fan connector, rotate the impeller by hand and measure the motor windings
solutions.ur: Fan connector check karein, impeller ko haath se ghumayein aur motor ki windings naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor fan motor, or the indoor PCB if the motor tests good
solutions.ur: Indoor fan motor badlein, ya agar motor ki test theek aaye to indoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S1]

notes.en: Written as 'Pb' on remote displays and 'PB' in check tables — same code.
notes.ur: Remote displays par 'Pb' likha jata hai aur check tables mein 'PB' — wahi code.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor upper lamp: 4-time flash, 2.5 s OFF (inverter only); also 11-time flash for rotation-feedback loss; wireless remote beeper: 11 times

title.ur: Outdoor refrigerant system mein kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor refrigerant circuit is abnormal — typically a gas leak, long pump-down or short-cycling condition.
meaning.ur: Outdoor refrigerant circuit abnormal hai — aam tor par gas leak, lamba pump-down ya short cycling ki wajah se.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak in the connecting pipes or indoor/outdoor joints
causes.ur: Connecting pipes ya indoor/outdoor joints mein refrigerant leak ho.

causes.en: Unit pumped down for a long time, low charge, or outdoor fan locked causing short cycle
causes.ur: Unit kaafi der se pump down rahi ho, charge kam ho, ya outdoor fan lock hone se short cycle bane.

solutions.en: Leak-test the whole circuit, repair the leak, evacuate and re-gas to specification
solutions.ur: Poore circuit ka leak-test karein, leak theek karein, vacuum karein aur specification ke mutabiq gas bharein.

solutions.en: Open the stop valves, check the outdoor fan motor and confirm the unit is not short cycling
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, outdoor fan motor check karein aur confirm karein ke unit short cycle nahi kar rahi.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S1]

notes.en: Condition text on the official ME Malaysia page: 'Unit has been pump down for a long time / Refrigerant amount is low / Unit is short cycling / Outdoor fan motor locks up'.
notes.ur: Official ME Malaysia page ka condition text: 'Unit ko kaafi der se pump down kiya gaya hai / Refrigerant kam hai / Unit short cycle kar rahi hai / Outdoor fan motor lock ho jata hai'.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor upper lamp: 14-time flash, 2.5 s OFF; wireless remote beeper: 14 times

title.en: Combination error between indoor and outdoor unit
title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ka combination sahi nahi

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units cannot be used together — capacity code, connected-unit count or model combination is invalid.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units aik sath use nahi ho sakte — capacity code, connected unit ki tadaad ya model combination ghalat hai.

causes.en: Wrong capacity code (SW2) set on the indoor board
causes.ur: Indoor board par capacity code (SW2) galat set ho.

causes.en: Wrong number of connected indoor units / branch boxes, or incompatible models
causes.ur: Connected indoor units / branch boxes ki tadaad galat ho, ya models match nahi karte.

solutions.en: Correct the SW2 capacity code and the outdoor model-selection dip switches (SW5-3…SW5-8)
solutions.ur: SW2 capacity code aur outdoor model-selection dip switches (SW5-3…SW5-8) theek karein.

solutions.en: Power down for 5 minutes, correct the connection count within limits, then power up again
solutions.ur: 5 minute ke liye power band karein, connection ki tadaad limit ke andar theek karein, phir dobara power on karein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S2]

notes.en: Shows as EF/7100-family on City Multi when the system is on M-Net.
notes.ur: Jab system M-Net par hota hai to City Multi par yeh EF/7100-family ke tor par dikhta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: 7 times

title.ur: Non-defined error / M-NET transmission kharab

meaning.en: An undefined check code, usually noise on the transmission line or an M-NET communication disturbance.
meaning.ur: Check code ki definition nahi hai, aam tor par transmission line par noayz ya M-NET communication mein kharabi.

causes.en: Noise interference on the remote-controller or indoor/outdoor connecting wire
causes.ur: Remote-controller ya indoor/outdoor connecting wire par noise interference ho.

causes.en: Wrong controller type (e.g. MA remote PAR-21MAA) fitted on the line
causes.ur: Line par ghalat controller type laga ho (misal ke tor par MA remote PAR-21MAA).

solutions.en: Power down the outdoor unit for 30 seconds and switch it back on, then re-read the code
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ko 30 second ke liye band karein aur phir on karein, us ke baad code dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Check earth bonding, cable type and controller type; re-check after removing the noise source
solutions.ur: Earth bonding, cable type aur controller type check karein; noise source hatane ke baad dobara check karein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S8]

notes.en: EF is the 'non-defined' bucket — treat it as a wiring/noise investigation, not a part failure.
notes.ur: EF 'non-defined' category hai — isay wiring/noayz ki investigation maano, kisi part ki kharabi nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: P-Series A: LED1 2 flashes / LED2 4 flashes; central controller 6607

title.ur: Remote controller ke bhejne aur lenay mein ghalti

meaning.en: The remote controller could not receive (or send) a valid signal to/from the unit.
meaning.ur: Remote controller unit se valid signal receive (ya bhej) nahi kar saka.

causes.en: Remote controller receiving/transmitting circuit fault or weak batteries
causes.ur: Remote controller ki receiving/transmitting circuit kharab ho ya batteries kamzor hon.

causes.en: Noise or poor wiring on the remote-controller line; wrong master/slave setting
causes.ur: Remote-controller line par noise ho ya wiring kamzor ho; master/slave setting galat ho.

solutions.en: Replace the remote batteries, move within 2 m and re-run the CHECK procedure
solutions.ur: Remote ki batteries badlein, 2 meter ke andar aayein aur CHECK procedure dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Check the remote wiring, master/slave (group) settings and eliminate noise sources
solutions.ur: Remote ki wiring, master/slave (group) settings check karein aur noise sources khatam karein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S11]

notes.en: S2 groups E0/E3 as 'Remote controller transmission error'.
notes.ur: S2 E0/E3 ko 'Remote controller transmission error' ke tor par group karta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: no fixed count (shown as '-' in S2); P-Series A: LED1 2 flashes / LED2 3 flashes

title.ur: Remote controller ke control board mein ghalti

meaning.en: The remote controller's own control board is faulty (or its address setting is wrong in a grouped system).
meaning.ur: Remote controller ka apna control board kharab hai (ya grouped system mein us ki address setting ghalat hai).

causes.en: Faulty remote-controller control board
causes.ur: Remote-controller control board kharab ho.

causes.en: Wrong addressing when several remotes are grouped or twinned
causes.ur: Kai remotes group ya twin hone par address galat set ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check the addressing / master-slave settings; on twinned systems confirm wiring goes to the master indoor only
solutions.ur: Addressing / master-slave settings check karein; twinned systems par confirm karein ke wiring sirf master indoor par jati hai.

solutions.en: Replace the remote controller if the code persists with a known-good indoor unit
solutions.ur: Agar ache indoor unit ke sath bhi code barqarar rahe to remote controller badlein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S11]

notes.en: Do not confuse with bulao.pk's 'E1 = indoor room temperature sensor' (quarantined, Q1).
notes.ur: Isay bulao.pk ke 'E1 = indoor room temperature sensor' ke sath ghalat mat samajhein (quarantined, Q1).

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: shown as '-' in S2; P-Series A: LED1/LED2 not used

title.ur: Remote controller ke control board ki ghalti (dusra code)

meaning.en: Second remote-controller control-board fault code, used when more than one abnormal point exists on the controller.
meaning.ur: Remote controller ke control board ki dusri ghalti ka code, jo controller par ek se zyada abnormal point hone par istemal hota hai.

causes.en: Faulty remote-controller control board
causes.ur: Remote-controller control board kharab ho.

causes.en: Wrong addressing in grouped or twinned installations
causes.ur: Grouped ya twinned installations mein address galat ho.

solutions.en: Verify group addressing and the master indoor connection
solutions.ur: Group addressing aur master indoor ka connection verify karein.

solutions.en: Replace the remote controller if the fault follows the remote
solutions.ur: Agar fault remote ke sath sath jata rahe to remote controller badlein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S11]

notes.en: S8 lists E1/E2 without LED flash codes — confirm on the remote display only.
notes.ur: S8 mein E1/E2 bina LED flash codes ke diye gaye hain — sirf remote display par confirm karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Grouped with E1 as 'Remote controller control board error'

title.ur: Remote controller ka signal nahi bhej pa raha

meaning.en: The remote controller is not transmitting its signal to the indoor unit.
meaning.ur: Remote controller indoor unit ko apna signal nahi bhej raha.

causes.en: Remote controller transmitting circuit fault
causes.ur: Remote controller ki transmitting circuit kharab ho.

causes.en: Wiring/termination fault or noise on the remote line
causes.ur: Remote line par wiring/termination mein masla ho ya noise ho.

solutions.en: Check remote-controller wiring and connectors; replace batteries and retry
solutions.ur: Remote-controller ki wiring aur connectors check karein; batteries badlein aur dobara koshish karein.

solutions.en: If other codes appear instead, replace the remote controller
solutions.ur: Agar uski jagah dusre codes aayein to remote controller badlein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S11]

notes.en: S12 defines E3 as remote-control transmission error located at the remote control.
notes.ur: S12 E3 ko remote control par milne wala transmission error define karta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: P-Series A: LED1 2 flashes / LED2 3 flashes

title.ur: Remote ka signal indoor nahi samajh pa raha

meaning.en: The indoor unit cannot receive the remote controller's signal.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit remote controller ka signal receive nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Remote controller not transmitting, or out of range / obstacles
causes.ur: Remote controller transmit na kare, ya range se bahar / rukawat ho.

causes.en: Indoor receiver circuit or wiring fault, electrical noise
causes.ur: Indoor receiver circuit ya wiring mein masla ho, ya electrical noise ho.

solutions.en: Move within 2 m, point at the receiver and retry the CHECK procedure with fresh batteries
solutions.ur: 2 meter ke andar aayein, receiver ki taraf point karein aur nayi batteries ke sath CHECK procedure dobara karein.

solutions.en: Turn off noise sources (inverter lamps, TV, speakers) and check the remote wiring
solutions.ur: Noise sources band karein (inverter lamps, TV, speakers) aur remote ki wiring check karein.

source.title: Mr. Slim / split A-control check codes (P/E/U/F/A letter+digit + LED flash) [S1]

notes.en: S12 separates E4 (receiving, indoor) from E5 (transmitting, indoor).
notes.ur: S12 mein E4 (receiving, indoor) aur E5 (transmitting, indoor) alag alag rakhe gaye hain.

codes.blinkPattern: Wireless remote beeper: 9 times (grouped with E5)

title.ur: Remote ka signal indoor tak nahi ja raha

meaning.en: The indoor unit reports the remote controller's transmission path as faulty.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ke mutabiq remote controller ka transmission raasta kharab hai.

causes.en: Remote controller transmitting circuit fault
causes.ur: Remote controller ki transmitting circuit kharab ho.

causes.en: Wiring fault or noise on the remote line
causes.ur: Remote line par wiring mein masla ho ya noise ho.

solutions.en: Check the remote wiring and connectors, then re-run the CHECK procedure
solutions.ur: Remote ki wiring aur connectors check karein, phir CHECK procedure dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Replace the remote controller if the fault follows it
solutions.ur: Agar fault remote ke sath sath jata rahe to remote controller badlein.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan signal nahi mil raha

meaning.en: Serial signal between indoor and outdoor units is missing or being received incorrectly (indoor side).
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units ke darmiyan serial signal nahi aa raha ya ghalat mil raha hai (indoor side).

causes.en: Outdoor unit powered up before the indoor unit at start-up
causes.ur: Start-up par indoor unit se pehle outdoor unit on ho jaye.

causes.en: Mis-wiring / open circuit on S1-S2-S3, or a drain pump wired into S1 and S2 injecting noise
causes.ur: S1-S2-S3 par galat wiring/open circuit ho, ya drain pump S1 aur S2 par laga kar noise dale.

causes.en: Noise entry into the connecting wire or a failed indoor/outdoor P.C. board
causes.ur: Connecting wire mein noise ghus jaye, ya indoor/outdoor P.C. board fail ho jaye.

solutions.en: Power up indoor first, then outdoor; if locked out, switch the outdoor power off for 3–5 minutes and re-apply
solutions.ur: Pehle indoor power on karein, phir outdoor; agar lock out ho jaye to outdoor power 3–5 minute band karein aur phir dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Check S1/S2/S3 wiring and voltages (control 10–24 Vdc between S2 and S3), remove pumps from the signal path, and re-check
solutions.ur: S1/S2/S3 ki wiring aur voltages check karein (control 10–24 Vdc, S2 aur S3 ke darmiyan), signal path se pumps hatayein, aur dobara check karein.

title.ur: Indoor/outdoor communication error — signal nahi gaya (transmitting, indoor)

meaning.en: The indoor unit cannot transmit to the outdoor unit (serial signal transmission side).
meaning.ur: Indoor unit outdoor unit ko signal nahi bhej sakta (serial signal transmission side).

causes.en: Same power-up order / wiring issues as E6
causes.ur: Yeh E6 jaisa hi power-up order / wiring masla hai.

causes.en: Condensate pump wired across S2-S3, low 12/24 Vdc on S2-S3, or a failing indoor board
causes.ur: Condensate pump S2-S3 par laga ho, S2-S3 par 12/24 Vdc kam ho, ya indoor board fail ho raha ho.

solutions.en: Measure 12/24 Vdc on S2 and S3 at the outdoor terminal block and check for grounded S3
solutions.ur: Outdoor terminal block par S2 aur S3 se 12/24 Vdc naapein aur grounded S3 ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Re-power in the correct order (indoor then outdoor) and replace the indoor P.C. board if voltage is correct but the code remains
solutions.ur: Sahi tarteeb se dobara power dein (pehle indoor phir outdoor) aur agar voltage theek ho lekin code rahe to indoor P.C. board badlein.

causes.ur: Indoor se pehle outdoor on ho jaye, ya operation ke doran indoor isolator band ho.

causes.ur: Indoor-outdoor connecting wire par noise ho ya galat wiring ho.

solutions.ur: Pehle indoor phir outdoor ko dobara power dein; S2/S3 par 10–24 Vdc control signal verify karein.

solutions.en: Check the connecting wire and replace the indoor or outdoor P.C. board if the code recurs after a clean re-check
solutions.ur: Connecting wire check karein aur agar saaf re-check ke baad bhi code wapas aaye to indoor ya outdoor P.C. board badlein.

title.en: Mis-wiring or too many indoor units
title.ur: Indoor/outdoor ki ghalat wiring ya units zyada

meaning.en: The indoor/outdoor connecting wire is mis-wired or the number of connected indoor units exceeds the outdoor unit's limit.
meaning.ur: Indoor/outdoor ki connecting wire galat lagi hai ya lage hue indoor units ki tadaad outdoor unit ki limit se zyada hai.

causes.en: More indoor units connected than allowed
causes.ur: Allowed se zyada indoor units jude hue hain.

causes.en: Converse wiring / disconnection of the connecting cable, or noise
causes.ur: Connecting cable ki wiring ulti ho ya cable khudi juda ho, ya noise ho.

solutions.en: Check the number of indoor units against the outdoor unit limit and re-terminate S1-S2-S3 correctly
solutions.ur: Indoor units ki tadaad outdoor unit limit se compare karein aur S1-S2-S3 ko sahi tarah dobara terminate karein.

solutions.en: Power down, re-check the wiring, then power up and re-read the code
solutions.ur: Power band karein, wiring dobara check karein, phir power on karke code dobara parhein.

meaning.ur: Indoor/outdoor ki connecting cable khuli hai, ulti lagi hai ya us ki termination theek nahi hui.

causes.ur: Interconnecting cable dhili ho ya toot jaye.

solutions.ur: Connecting cable ko end-to-end dobara terminate karein aur continuity test karein.

solutions.ur: Specified cable size istemal karein aur noise sources hatane ke baad dobara check karein.

causes.ur: Noise interference ho ya cable ka size/specification ghalat ho.

solutions.ur: Breaker band karein, thori der rukein aur dobara power dein taake theek se initialise ho sake.

solutions.ur: Connecting cable ki specification check karein, noise sources hatayein aur phir code dobara parhein.

title.en: Serial communication error between outdoor boards
title.ur: Outdoor boards ke darmiyan serial communication kharab

meaning.en: Serial communication between the outdoor control boards (or M-Net interface board) has failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor control boards (ya M-Net interface board) ke darmiyan serial communication kharab ho gayi hai.

causes.en: M-Net interface board incorrectly fitted
causes.ur: M-Net interface board ghalat tareeqe se laga hua ho.

causes.en: Loose CN2/CN4 connectors or a failed communication circuit on the power board
causes.ur: CN2/CN4 connectors dhile hon ya power board par communication circuit fail ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check the CN2/CN4 connectors and confirm the M-Net interface board is correctly installed
solutions.ur: CN2/CN4 connectors check karein aur confirm karein ke M-Net interface board sahi tarah installed hai.

solutions.en: Replace the inverter / outdoor power P.C. board if the fault recurs after re-seating
solutions.ur: Dobara theek se lagane ke baad bhi fault wapas aaye to inverter / outdoor power P.C. board badlein.

title.en: Abnormal high pressure (63H high-pressure switch operated)
title.ur: High pressure abnormal hai (63H high pressure switch chala)

meaning.en: The high-pressure switch 63H/TRS has tripped, or high pressure is detected in the system.
meaning.ur: High pressure switch 63H/TRS chala hai, ya system mein high pressure detect hua hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan failure or blocked/dirty outdoor heat exchanger and filters
causes.ur: Outdoor fan fail ho jaye ya outdoor heat exchanger/filters band ya ganda hon.

causes.en: Short air cycle around the outdoor unit, or indoor filter blocked during heating
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ke ird-gird short air cycle ho, ya heating ke doran indoor filter block ho.

causes.en: High-pressure switch connector open / LEV malfunction
causes.ur: High-pressure switch connector khula ho ya LEV mein masla ho.

solutions.en: Check and clean the heat exchangers and filters, confirm the outdoor fan runs, and check for a short air cycle
solutions.ur: Heat exchangers aur filters check karke saaf karein, confirm karein ke outdoor fan chal raha hai aur short air cycle ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Check the 63H/TRS connector continuity and the LEV operation; reset only after pressures are confirmed normal
solutions.ur: 63H/TRS connector ki continuity aur LEV ka kaam check karein; sirf pressures normal confirm hone ke baad reset karein.

title.ur: Discharge temperature zyada ya refrigerant kam

meaning.en: Discharge temperature is too high, the compressor inner thermostat 49C has operated, or the charge is low.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature bohat zyada hai, compressor ka andar thermostat 49C chala hai, ya charge kam hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage / gas leak
causes.ur: Refrigerant ki kami ho ya gas leak ho.

causes.en: Faulty discharge thermistor TH4 or high ambient running conditions
causes.ur: Discharge thermistor TH4 kharab ho ya operating conditions bohat zyada hon.

causes.en: 49C inner thermostat (or external klixon) tripping
causes.ur: 49C inner thermostat (ya external klixon) trip kar jaye.

solutions.en: Leak-test, re-gas and verify discharge temperature with the service tool
solutions.ur: Leak-test karein, dobara gas bharein aur service tool se discharge temperature verify karein.

solutions.en: Measure TH4 and check condenser airflow/ambient; inspect 49C only after confirming pressures
solutions.ur: TH4 naapein aur condenser ki airflow/ambient check karein; 49C sirf pressures confirm hone ke baad dekhein.

title.ur: Discharge temperature thermistor open ya short ho gaya hai

meaning.en: The discharge temperature thermistor (TH4) is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature thermistor (TH4) open ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Thermistor open/short or disconnected from the board
causes.ur: Thermistor open/short ho jaye ya board se alag ho jaye.

causes.en: Damaged lead wire / pinched cable
causes.ur: Lead wire damage ho jaye ya cable dab jaye.

solutions.en: Measure TH4 resistance and check connectors on the outdoor controller board
solutions.ur: TH4 ki resistance naapein aur outdoor controller board par connectors check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor, or the outdoor board if the reading is normal but the code persists
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein, ya agar reading normal ho lekin code barqarar rahe to outdoor board badlein.

meaning.en: One or more outdoor thermistors (defrost, fin, P.C. board, ambient, outdoor heat exchanger) read open or short.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ka koi ya kai thermistor (defrost, fin, P.C. board, ambient, outdoor heat exchanger) open ya short dikha raha hai.

causes.en: Thermistor open/short or connector not seated
causes.ur: Thermistor open/short ho jaye ya connector baitha na ho.

causes.ur: Lead wire damage ho ya outdoor controller input circuit fail ho jaye.

solutions.en: Measure each outdoor thermistor against the resistance table and check all connectors
solutions.ur: Har outdoor thermistor ko resistance table se naapein aur sab connectors check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the faulty thermistor, or the outdoor controller board if all readings are normal
solutions.ur: Jo thermistor kharab ho use badlein, ya agar sab readings normal hon to outdoor controller board badlein.

title.en: Inverter heat sink temperature too high
title.ur: Inverter heat sink temperature bahut zyada

meaning.en: The inverter heat sink has overheated (TH8/THHS out of range), so the drive backs off or stops.
meaning.ur: Inverter heat sink zyada garm ho gaya hai (TH8/THHS out of range), jis se drive back off ya band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Blocked airflow through the heat sink or failed inverter fan
causes.ur: Heat sink ka airflow block ho ya inverter fan fail ho jaye.

causes.en: Missing silicone paste / poorly mounted IGBT
causes.ur: Silicone paste na lagi ho ya IGBT theek se mounted na ho.

causes.en: Faulty heat sink thermistor
causes.ur: Heat sink thermistor kharab ho.

solutions.en: Clear the air passage around the heat sink and check the inverter fan
solutions.ur: Heat sink ke ird-gird ka rasta saaf karein aur inverter fan check karein.

solutions.en: Read the heat sink temperature on the service tool (or PAR-21) and replace the thermistor/board if it reads incorrectly
solutions.ur: Service tool (ya PAR-21) se heat sink ka temperature parhein aur agar ghalat aaye to thermistor/board badlein.

meaning.en: Overcurrent was detected at the compressor or the inverter power module reports a fault.
meaning.ur: Compressor par overcurrent detect hua ya inverter power module fault report kar raha hai.

causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring dhili, khuli ya ulti lage ho jaye.

causes.ur: Compressor lock/seize ho jaye ya IPM / outdoor power board kharab ho.

solutions.ur: Inverter output test aur compressor ke electrical checks karein; winding ki resistance naapein.

solutions.ur: Supply voltage check karein aur compressor connector ko kassi karke dobara lagayein; agar module kharab ho to power board badlein.

causes.ur: TH4 ki reading ghalat ho ya woh juda hua ho.

causes.ur: LEV coil/connector alag ho jaye ya LEV ka performance fail ho jaye.

solutions.en: Verify the TH4 reading against actual temperature and check the connector
solutions.ur: TH4 ki reading asal temperature se compare karein aur connector check karein.

solutions.en: Check LEV operation and refrigerant charge; correct the charge if needed
solutions.ur: LEV ka kaam aur refrigerant charge check karein; zaroorat ho to charge theek karein.

meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor band ho gaya ya us ki speed abnormal hai, jis se protection chali hai.

causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor fail ho jaye ya bearing jam ho jaye.

causes.ur: CNF connector dhila ho ya outdoor multi controller board mein masla ho.

solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor aur uska connector (CNF) check karein aur koi rukawat hata dein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor, or the outdoor board if the motor tests good
solutions.ur: Fan motor badlein, ya agar motor ki test theek aaye to outdoor board badlein.

meaning.ur: Over voltage ya under voltage, ya main circuit par synchronising signal abnormal hai.

causes.ur: Mains voltage allowed range se bahar ho (PK mein voltage swings aam hain).

causes.ur: CN2/CN5 alag ho jaye ya primary current sensor fail ho jaye.

solutions.ur: Phases par supply voltage naapein aur agar mains unstable ho to stabiliser lagayein/verify karein.

solutions.ur: CN2/CN5 connectors aur current sensor check karein; supply stable hone ke baad dobara chalayein.

solutions.ur: Load normal confirm karne ke baad current sensor ya outdoor power board badlein.

causes.ur: Outdoor LEV (LEV-A) malfunction/blockage ho.

solutions.en: Fully open the liquid and gas service valves and re-check
solutions.ur: Liquid aur gas service valves puri tarah kholein aur dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Check LEV-A operation and clear any blockage before re-gassing
solutions.ur: Gas dobara bharein se pehle LEV-A ka kaam check karein aur blockage door karein.

title.ur: Compressor overcurrent se interruption (outdoor power system)

meaning.en: The compressor was stopped because an overcurrent condition was detected in the outdoor power system.
meaning.ur: Outdoor power system mein overcurrent ki condition detect hone ki wajah se compressor band kar diya gaya.

causes.en: Compressor connector loose / disconnected
causes.ur: Compressor connector dhila ho ya juda na ho.

causes.en: Inverter or compressor fault, stop valve closed
causes.ur: Inverter ya compressor mein masla ho, ya stop valve band ho.

causes.en: Decreased supply voltage
causes.ur: Supply voltage kam ho jaye.

solutions.en: Reconnect the compressor connector and inspect the wiring for looseness or reversal
solutions.ur: Compressor connector dobara lagayein aur wiring mein dhilapan ya ulti lagne ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Check the inverter and compressor, open the stop valves, and confirm the supply voltage
solutions.ur: Inverter aur compressor check karein, stop valves kholein aur supply voltage confirm karein.

title.ur: Overheat ki protection (TH3 / 63HS saturation temperature)

meaning.en: Overheat protection has operated when the relevant temperature (TH3 or 63HS saturation) reached the trip point.
meaning.ur: Jab mumayim temperature (TH3 ya 63HS saturation) trip point tak aa gayi to overheat protection chal di.

causes.en: Reduced airflow through the condenser or dirty heat exchanger
causes.ur: Condenser ka airflow kam ho ya heat exchanger ganda ho.

causes.en: Faulty TH3 thermistor or high-pressure sensor input
causes.ur: TH3 thermistor kharab ho ya high-pressure sensor input mein masla ho.

solutions.en: Clean the heat exchanger and confirm fan operation and airflow
solutions.ur: Heat exchanger saaf karein aur fan ki operation aur airflow confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure TH3 against the resistance table and replace the sensor if it is out of range
solutions.ur: TH3 ko resistance table se naapein aur agar range se bahar ho to sensor badlein.

title.ur: Compressor overcurrent — compressor jam gaya

meaning.en: Overcurrent was interrupted because the compressor was locked at start-up or during operation.
meaning.ur: Overcurrent rok diya gaya kyunke compressor start-up par ya chalta hua lock ho gaya tha.

causes.en: Closed stop valve or decreased supply voltage
causes.ur: Stop valve band ho ya supply voltage kam ho jaye.

causes.en: Loose/reversed compressor wiring or wrong model-selection DIP switch
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring dhili/ulti ho ya model-selection DIP switch ghalat ho.

causes.en: Defective compressor or outdoor power board
causes.ur: Compressor ya outdoor power board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Open the stop valves, verify supply voltage and check the SW5 model-selection switches
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, supply voltage verify karein aur SW5 model-selection switches check karein.

solutions.en: Check compressor windings and connections; replace the compressor or power board after isolation
solutions.ur: Compressor ki windings aur connections check karein; isolation ke baad compressor ya power board badlein.

title.ur: Phase ki ulat (reverse phase)

meaning.en: The phase rotation of the incoming 3-phase supply is reversed.
meaning.ur: Aane wali 3-phase supply ka phase rotation ulat gaya hai.

causes.en: Phase rotation of the supply is wrong
causes.ur: Supply ki phase rotation ghalat ho.

causes.en: Loss of a phase through the noise filter, or a blown fuse
causes.ur: Noise filter ki wajah se koi phase gayab ho jaye ya fuse uda ho.

solutions.en: Swap any two phases at the outdoor power supply and re-power
solutions.ur: Outdoor power supply par koi bhi do phases aapas mein badlein aur dobara power dein.

solutions.en: Check fuses, the noise filter and incoming supply voltage
solutions.ur: Fuses, noise filter aur incoming supply voltage check karein.

title.ur: 63L low pressure switch open ho gaya hai

meaning.en: The low-pressure switch 63L is open (disconnected, contact failure, or genuine low pressure).
meaning.ur: Low pressure switch 63L open hai — disconnect, contact failure ya asal mein pressure kam hona.

causes.en: 63L switch disconnected or contact failure
causes.ur: 63L switch juda ho jaye ya contact fail ho.

causes.en: Low charge / blocked filter causing genuine low pressure
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam ho ya filter block ho jis se asal low pressure bane.

solutions.en: Check the 63L wiring and continuity with a tester
solutions.ur: 63L ki wiring aur tester se continuity check karein.

solutions.en: If continuity is good, check the refrigerant charge and filter condition
solutions.ur: Continuity theek ho to refrigerant charge aur filter ki halat check karein.

title.ur: 63H high pressure switch open ho gaya hai

meaning.en: The high-pressure switch 63H/TRS is open — disconnected, contact failure or real high pressure.
meaning.ur: High pressure switch 63H/TRS open hai — disconnect, contact failure ya asal mein pressure zyada hona.

causes.en: 63H/TRS switch disconnected or contact failure
causes.ur: 63H/TRS switch juda ho jaye ya contact fail ho.

causes.en: Blocked condenser, faulty outdoor fan or overcharge causing genuine high pressure
causes.ur: Condenser block, outdoor fan kharab ho ya overcharge ki wajah se asal high pressure bane.

solutions.en: Check the 63H/TRS connector on the outdoor board and the switch continuity
solutions.ur: Outdoor board par 63H/TRS connector aur switch ki continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Investigate high-pressure causes: clean the coil, check the fan, verify charge
solutions.ur: High-pressure ki wajahen dhundein: coil saaf karein, fan check karein aur charge verify karein.

title.ur: 51CM overcurrent relay ka connector open ho gaya hai

meaning.en: The 51CM overcurrent relay contact is open (trip or contact failure).
meaning.ur: 51CM overcurrent relay ka contact open hai (trip ya contact failure).

causes.en: Thermal relay tripped or contact failure
causes.ur: Thermal relay trip ho jaye ya contact fail ho.

causes.en: Defective relay board / genuine overcurrent
causes.ur: Relay board kharab ho ya asal overcurrent ho.

solutions.en: Check the 51CM relay connection and reset it only after confirming compressor current is normal
solutions.ur: 51CM relay ka connection check karein aur sirf compressor current normal confirm hone ke baad reset karein.

solutions.en: Check the relay board if the contact does not close with the system healthy
solutions.ur: Agar system healthy hone ke baad bhi contact close na ho to relay board check karein.

title.ur: Memory ke data mein ghalti

meaning.en: Data in the non-volatile memory of the outdoor/inverter board could not be read correctly.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ya inverter board ki non-volatile memory ka data theek se parha nahi ja saka.

causes.en: Corrupted EEPROM data on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par EEPROM data corrupt ho jaye.

causes.en: Power interruption during write, or board failure
causes.ur: Write ke doran power interruption aaye ya board fail ho jaye.

solutions.en: Power-cycle and re-read; if the code persists, replace the inverter P.C. board
solutions.ur: Power-cycle dein aur dobara parhein; agar code barqarar rahe to inverter P.C. board badlein.

solutions.en: After board replacement, re-enter the model-selection settings
solutions.ur: Board badlene ke baad model-selection settings dobara enter karein.

title.ur: Voltage alag hai (supply/phase ki mismatch)

meaning.en: The unit detected a voltage condition different from its configured supply (e.g. wrong voltage setting or single/three-phase mismatch).
meaning.ur: Unit ne apni set ki hui supply se alag voltage ki condition parya ki, jaise galat voltage setting ya single/three phase ki mismatch.

causes.en: Unit configured for a different supply voltage/phase
causes.ur: Unit kisi doosre supply voltage/phase ke liye configured ho.

causes.en: Unstable or unbalanced mains supply
causes.ur: Mains supply unstable ya unbalanced ho.

solutions.en: Verify the nameplate voltage/phase against the actual supply and correct the setting
solutions.ur: Nameplate ka voltage/phase asal supply se compare karein aur setting theek karein.

solutions.en: Stabilise the supply and re-check after power-cycling
solutions.ur: Supply ko stable karein aur power-cycle ke baad dobara check karein.

title.en: Duplicate address on the transmission line
title.ur: Transmission line par duplicate address

meaning.en: Two or more units (outdoor, indoor, Lossnay or remote) are set to the same address.
meaning.ur: Do ya zyada units (outdoor, indoor, Lossnay ya remote) ka aik hi address set kiya gaya hai.

causes.en: Duplicate address setting after a board replacement or commissioning change
causes.ur: Board change ya commissioning change ke baad duplicate address ban jaye.

causes.en: Noise interference on the indoor/outdoor connectors
causes.ur: Indoor/outdoor connectors par noise interference ho.

solutions.en: Re-assign unique addresses and power-cycle the system
solutions.ur: Unique addresses dobara assign karein aur system ka power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Check connectors for noise and re-read the code after restart
solutions.ur: Connectors ko noise ke liye check karein aur restart ke baad code dobara parhein.

title.en: Communication error with the communication processor
title.ur: Communication processor se communication error

meaning.en: The transmission processor did not exchange data (e.g. Lossnay address not transmitted).
meaning.ur: Transmission processor ne data exchange nahi kiya (jaise Lossnay ka address transmit nahi hua).

causes.en: M-Net wiring fault or transmission voltage out of range
causes.ur: M-Net wiring mein masla ho ya transmission voltage range se bahar ho.

causes.en: Faulty communication processor hardware or noise/lightning surge
causes.ur: Communication processor hardware kharab ho ya noise/lightning surge aaye.

solutions.en: Check M-Net wiring, polarity and line voltage
solutions.ur: M-Net wiring, polarity aur line voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Power down for 30 s and re-start; replace the board if the error recurs
solutions.ur: 30 second ke liye power dein aur phir restart karein; agar error dobara aaye to board badlein.

title.en: No ACK error on the transmission line
title.ur: Transmission line par ACK na milne ki ghalti

meaning.en: A unit on the M-Net line did not acknowledge a transmission request (no response from the addressed unit).
meaning.ur: M-Net line par kisi unit ne transmission request ka jawab (ACK) nahi diya (jise address diya gaya us se koi jawab nahi aaya).

causes.en: Address changed while powered, or a unit at the far end is missing
causes.ur: Power on rehte hue address badal gaya ho, ya door wali unit missing ho.

causes.en: Line too long / wrong cable type, too many units, or a failed controller
causes.ur: Line bohat lambi ho / cable ka type ghalat ho, units zyada hon ya controller fail ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check M-Net line voltage (~25 V), cable type (shielded CVVS/CPEVS/MVVS) and length limits (≤200 m farthest end)
solutions.ur: M-Net line voltage (~25 V), cable type (shielded CVVS/CPEVS/MVVS) aur length limits (farthest end ≤200 m) check karein.

solutions.en: Power down 5 minutes, restore power and re-read; replace the faulty controller if it persists
solutions.ur: 5 minute ke liye power dein, wapas power on karein aur dobara parhein; agar barqarar rahe to kharab controller badlein.

title.en: No response error on the transmission line
title.ur: Transmission line par koi jawab nahi aaya

meaning.en: No response frame came back on the transmission line — usually noise, cable problems or too many units.
meaning.ur: Transmission line par koi jawab frame wapas nahi aaya — aam tor par noayz, cable ki kharabi ya bohat zyada units.

causes.en: Continuous transmission failure caused by noise
causes.ur: Noise ki wajah se continuous transmission failure ho.

causes.en: Line voltage/signal drop beyond limits or wrong wire diameter
causes.ur: Line voltage/signal limits se bahar gir jaye ya wire diameter ghalat ho.

causes.en: Faulty controller at the source of the error
causes.ur: Error ke source par controller hi kharab ho.

solutions.en: Power down for 5 minutes, then restore power and re-read the code
solutions.ur: 5 minute ke liye power dein, phir wapas power on karein aur code dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Verify line type, diameter ≥1.25 mm², remote-controller line ≤12 m, and farthest unit ≤200 m
solutions.ur: Line type verify karein, diameter ≥1.25 mm², remote-controller line ≤12 m aur farthest unit ≤200 m hona chahiye.
